missions.title: 190 widows fed in Kaisagat and Bwai
missions.headline: 190 widows fed
story: On April 15th, Missions for Orphans, led by Pastor Jim and Mike, served two groups of widows from Kaisagat and Bwai.
In total, 190 women received maize flour and beans to help sustain their households. It may seem simple, but moments like these carry real weight for the families who depend on them.
We're grateful to play even a small part in supporting these women, and thankful for the hands and hearts that made it possible.
missions.alt: Widows from Kaisagat and Bwai at the April food distribution
missions.summary: Led by Pastor Jim and Mike, we served two groups of widows from Kaisagat and Bwai. In total, 190 women received maize flour and beans to help sustain their households.

missions.title: 10 wheelchairs for St. Lilian School
missions.headline: 10 wheelchairs
story: On January 23, 2026, we visited St. Lilian School for Physically Challenged Children and gave 10 wheelchairs to children in need, helping them move more freely and comfortably every day.
Each wheelchair costs $160, $1,600 in all. The need is still great: many more children are waiting. With your help, we can reach them.
missions.alt: Children at St. Lilian School with their new wheelchairs

missions.title: 506 widows in six villages
missions.headline: 506 widows served
story: On December 16, 2025, we served 506 widows across six communities: Wiyeta, Munyaka, Karaus, Kwayu, Bwai and Kaisagat. Each woman received 1 kg of sugar and tea leaves.
Together they prayed for Missions for Orphans, asking God to expand our reach so we can keep serving those in need.
missions.alt: Widows from six villages at the December distribution

missions.title: A home for Mary Esekhon
missions.headline: 1 new home
story: Meet Mary Esekhon, a widow of 27 years and mother of seven. After the heartbreaking loss of three of her children, she cares for her four remaining children with strength and grace.
Thanks to our supporters, Mary's new home is in progress: a safe, lasting place for her family. We'll share more as it goes up.
missions.alt: Mary Esekhon's new home being built
missions.summary: A widow of 27 years and mother of seven, Mary cares for her four remaining children. Thanks to our supporters, her new home is going up.

missions.title: 12 baskets for the mamas
missions.headline: $165 for 12 baskets
story: It's basket time again! We put together 12 baskets of everyday essentials for the mamas in need around our property: simple things that make a hard week a little lighter.
The total came to just $165, proof that small amounts make a big difference.
missions.alt: Baskets of everyday essentials for widows

missions.title: Looking back at the widows’ homes
missions.headline: 2 rooms in every new home
story: We looked back on our journey of building homes for widows and saw how far it has come: from simple 8 by 8 foot spaces to today’s 15 by 20 foot homes with two rooms.
What started as a check on past builds became a reminder of what these homes mean to the families living in them.
